title: Outdoor Mall, like Orange County Mall
content: Hi all! Last night I was at the outdoor mall again. It reminded me a lot of the large outdoor Orange County Mall (Southern California, my home state). It was nice and sunny out, very few clouds in the sky. Vague shops storefronts with large bay windows displaying goods, and someone left a red radio flyer wagon out. In the wagon was a small throw blanket and a pink pillow. I walked toward the wagon and a girl shouted after me "Hey! That's mine!" I look over and a man and his young daughter were on the other side of the corridor window shopping. I apologized and embarrassingly headed to the parking lot to leave. The parking lot reminded me of the one at the Cypress swap meet parking lot it was huge and went on for miles, with rows upon rows of cement parking blocks and little grass islands. I finally find my vehicle, or at least I think I did, because next thing I know I am driving. Like normal driving, not like dream-driving and reaching over from the passenger side or back seat. I was trying to leave the intersection to turn right on to a major road, there were lots of pedestrians and shoppers at the crosswalk. If I continue straight instead of making a right a the intersection there is a HUGE multi-level movie theatre with big lights and banners. I kept driving down PCH and could see the ocean on my left as I drove...it was nice. Peaceful. \*\*I grew up in SoCal, so it was nice to be "home" again last night at my outdoor mall!
